about_the_game:
Want to have the bragging rights to say "I have a 1 in a million achievement on Steam"? Well today is your lucky day because that is what this entire game is based on.

Objective: Get a score of 1,000,000 all you have to do is click a button and hope it hits the 1,000,000 and you will now have that achievement, you can purchase upgrades that allow for an auto clicker and reduce the time between clicks

There are also side achievements that can be acquired such as 1% which is a score of 1, Full stop, which is a score of 999,999 and upgraded, which is acquired by purchasing all upgrades, if you get those 4 plus the 1 million, then you will have the King of Achievements achievement which is by far the rarest of rare when it comes to achievements, this game can take years to 100% or it could take a single day, it's all based on odds, you might get very lucky your first couple clicks
